g3.introScreen: Answer quickly. Each stage sends some home.

hint.default: Watch the room and use Skip if people are ready.
hint.lobby: Wait for everyone to scan the code, then press Start.
hint.wcf.prompt: Read the events aloud. Players will order them next.
hint.wcf.order: Players are ordering. Add time if lots haven't locked in.
hint.wcf.reveal: Walk through the timeline and read each reference.
hint.wcf.end: Show the podium, then close the room.
hint.fv.write: Check submissions and hide anything inappropriate.
hint.fv.vote: Read the options aloud. You can still hide one.
hint.fv.reveal: Read the verse and celebrate the best fake.
hint.fv.end: Show the podium, then close the room.
hint.wai.clue: A new, easier clue appears every 10 seconds.
hint.wai.reveal: Read the story line and the reference.
hint.wai.end: Show the podium, then close the room.
hint.g3.intro: Explain: each stage sends part of the crowd home.
hint.g3.s1q: Stage 1: everyone answers. Bottom third goes home.
hint.g3.s1r: Read the correct answer and its reference.
hint.g3.s1cut: The shofar sounds. Cheer the survivors.
hint.g3.s2q: Stage 2: speed matters as much as accuracy.
hint.g3.s2r: Read the correct answer and its reference.
hint.g3.s2cut: The finalists are chosen. Call them to the front.
hint.g3.s3pre: Watchmen are predicting who wins the next point.
hint.g3.s3q: First correct tap wins. Use Re-ask if it was unfair.
hint.g3.end: Crown the champion, then close the room.
hint.wolf.reveal: Everyone peeks at their phone. Remind them not to show it.
hint.wolf.clues: One clue word each. Press Next if someone says it aloud.
hint.wolf.debate: Free discussion. Encourage the quiet ones.
hint.wolf.accuse: Votes are revealed. Build the suspense.
hint.wolf.guess: A caught wolf has 15 seconds to guess the word.
hint.wolf.roundEnd: Reveal the word and who the wolves were.
hint.wolf.end: Show the podium, then close the room.
